limitations: Every nonempty plan includes coded AU 0. No bounded independent cold preroll or imported DSP checkpoint is qualified.
Logical positions are instance-bound and always require replay; source bytes must remain immutable.
Replay budget counts discarded AUs only. Existing input/index/workspace/duration limits still apply.
Planning checks metadata and scope; corrupt payloads or implicit extensions may still fail during execution.
Interval end is enforced by caller callback: trim final frame and stop before next AU.
No resampling: absolute rational phase and resampler history remain consumer responsibilities.
Short deterministic fuzz runs are regression smoke coverage, not exhaustive security proof.
No Windows/macOS/ARM validation, crate publication or deployment.
consumer_archive: Final consumer rerun uses the current packaged sources including the corrected unpublished local dependency example; consumer.log records its archive hash.
